title: Trace-ui control to promote a supporting question to an output
description:
Follow-up from flywheel52 (PR #16).

Current: the promoteSupportingQuestion GraphQL mutation (and WebStore.promote_supporting_question) exist, but trace-ui has no control for them.

Desired: on a classifier's supporting questions (from the run's latest checkpoint), a 'Make this an output' action that asks for the new classifier id, name and optional positive label, shows that it creates a new cyclotron version with a fresh replay, and calls promoteSupportingQuestion with confirmed:true only after explicit confirmation.

Acceptance: vitest covers the confirmation step (no mutation before confirm) and the mutation variables; glossary terms (output, supporting question, ML model) only; tsc and vitest green.
